response.justification: Bogdan is a highly accomplished senior/staff-level engineer with 15+ years of experience, far exceeding the entry-level scope of this Junior Java Developer role. The core mismatch is seniority: the position is an entry-level IC role and would almost certainly represent a significant step down in responsibility and compensation, creating high flight risk. Additionally, his technical depth is concentrated in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web/GIS platforms, with Java appearing only as a listed skill and in limited robotics/tooling work from 2016–2018 — not the modern Java enterprise stack this role centers on. Critically, the role requires strong verbal and written German, while his resume states only basic German. No insurance-sector experience is present. He would be an excellent candidate for a senior or staff-level opening, but is not a fit for this posting.
strengths: Exceptional breadth: 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Strong agile/craftsmanship practice (TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development)
CS degree, Berlin-based, plus proven client-facing teaching and workshop delivery
concerns: Severe over-qualification for an entry-level role; high attrition and compensation-mismatch risk
German listed as basic, but role requires strong verbal and written German
Java experience is dated and peripheral; no enterprise Java or insurance-domain exposure
